headline: Tencent's HY3 hits new peak; DeepSeek flash keeps climbing
summary: Tencent's hy3-20260706 notched an all-time token-share record of 17.3% (day 3 of the streak), while DeepSeek's flash variant extended its own record run to day 5 at 14.9%. Two new models entered the top 50—Google's gemini-3.5-flash and Moonshot AI's kimi-k2.7-code—as Zhipu AI jumped 2 ranks to #7 on a 1.4-point daily gain.
highlights: Tencent/hy3-20260706 at 17.3% token share (all-time high, day 3)
Zhipu AI/glm-5.2 +2 ranks to #7 (+1.4 points daily)
